text:
tara_sales: Starting thread for AcmeCo POC — they want Okta SAML SSO, SCIM for provisioning (50k initial), RBAC via group mapping, domain proofing, and a 2-week Dedicated burst quote. Need quick ops + security + pricing answers.

jon_se: Quick clarifying q: will Acme do Okta Group Push or use SCIM groups? Also do they want JIT on SAML login?

anna_acme: We can do SCIM groups. Wehave an export CSV for the initial 50k and prefer SCIM deltas afterwards. No JIT, prefer explicit provisioning.

jon_se: Recommend flow: presigned S3 CSV ingest for initial load (avoids 50k SCIM calls) then scoped SCIM token for deltas. Provide example mapping file.

lee_security: Security notes from questionnaire: 1) We support encrypted SAML assertions (RSA-OAEP + AES-GCM) if SP metadata provided. 2) Hosted SCIM uses TLS + bearer token; mTLS is available for Dedicated/Private. 3) Audit log retention: hosted default 90d, enterprise add-on for 12mo.

anna_acme: Procurement requires mTLS for provisioning and 12mo logs. They asked if mTLS possible on hosted trial.

lee_security: mTLS not available on hosted; needs Dedicated or Private. We can offer pro-rated Dedicated burst for 2 weeks with mTLS enabled.

jon_se: Ops checklist for POC: 1) exchange SP metadata (we give ACS + EntityID), 2) confirm CSV schema, 3) share group->role mapping (example below), 4) confirm Dedicated burst sizing (target TPS).

jon_se: Example mapping: {"okta_group":"acme_engineers","redwood_role":"developer"}

ops-bot: [ops-bot] Presigned S3 URL generated: https://storage.redwood.ai/presign/acme-poc (1 day expiry)

tara_sales: Action items: Anna to share SP metadata + S3 IAM role or accept presigned URL by EOD. Lee to attach SOC2 link and pen test summary. Jon to draft burst quote (pro-rated + daily cap). We'll reconvene after artifacts. :thumbsup:

anna_acme: Will send metadata and IAM role today. Thanks everyone.

lee_security: I'll post SOC2 link and encrypted-assertion config notes in 24h.

tara_sales: Great, closing for now — flagging blocker: if procurement insists on mTLS for hosted trial we'll need procurement/legal signoff or we move to Dedicated immediately.
